criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($5,800,000 - $5,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $1,200,000 is wrong.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 12 January 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 12 July 2030 (48 months after Closing).
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($325,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $64,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $64,300,000 is wrong.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $1,600,000 and the Seller's $1,200,000.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (12 January 2028; 12 July 2030) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 30 April 2026 (622 days).
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
